description: Weak, mixed unit. Strongest when the mover owns the 5th cell of the centre column (row 4, col 3) while column 2 is still empty or holds at most two stones, so the cell at row 3 of column 2 is floating; it is boosted by the mover's stones at rows 1-2 of column 1 (on that same rising diagonal) and a tall column 4. Filling column 2 switches it off. Many firings, especially sparse early boards, fit no pattern.
effect: None consistent: forcing it high or off shifts move probabilities by at most about 0.1, in different columns on different positions.
notes: Per-cell histograms: band 9 has mover at (4,3) 96% vs 25% in band 1, mover at (2,1) 73% vs 21%, column 2 low. act: X(2,1) and X(4,3) with column 2 empty are superadditive (1.2+1.3 -> 3.1); filling column 2 to height 2-3 kills it; the mirror pattern (columns 4/5) does not fire. Best dev F1 0.249 (P .17, R .45, AUROC .69), sim share 0.03; 7 scores, none above 0.25. Many boards that match do not fire, so the pattern explains the top band but not the threshold region. Possibly a random direction or a mixture.
